entries.8328080a9a6a2b51: This business operates the Saizeriya restaurant in China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore and Vietnam. As of the end of August 2025, the number of stores was 207 in Shanghai, 225 in Guangzhou, 81 in Beijing, 71 in Hong Kong, 24 in Taipei, 38 in Singapore and 1 in Vietnam. In Guangzhou, the company also manufactures ingredients used by the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥83,802 million.
